identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Repair terminal closeout and safe-prune recovery for closed issues

values.task_boundary: Implement and prove the smallest typed recovery surface that closes the identified terminal reconciliation and dirty-prune gaps, then run the live v0.91.8 sweep after merge.
deliverables: Typed prune-preparation classification and cleanup contract
Tracked recovery proof packet and post-merge sweep report
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #5691-style recorded-head versus merged-head drift is accepted only with exact repository, PR, branch, and ancestry proof
AC-2: unrelated or ambiguous terminal revisions fail closed
AC-3: safe cleanup removes only explicit generated categories or byte-equivalent retained evidence
AC-4: tracked lifecycle drift, source files, and unknown paths are never silently removed
AC-5: the operation is repeatable and existing validate-prune/prune gates remain authoritative
AC-6: closed earlier-phase issues receive a truthful next-typed-action classification without inferred transitions
AC-7: focused tests and exact-head review pass
AC-8: the live v0.91.8 sweep reports reconciled, pruned, and blocked issues separately
dependencies: Current C-SDLC v2 closeout receipt and prune implementation
Live merged PR truth from the typed GitHub owner binary
non_goals: No force removal of dirty worktrees
No inferred review, publication, readiness, or terminal success
